verdict.rationale: A tax authority could reasonably publish power-of-attorney or third-party authorization forms, delegate roles, and signature rules, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers any of it. The items on approved tax-preparer software, generic downloadable forms, and authenticated eSystems access are adjacent and do not define what a third party may or may not do on a taxpayer's behalf.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
